meta.title: Graphs Are Awesome
meta.author: Yohei Nakajima
meta.disclosure: FalkorDB is an Untapped Capital portfolio company. Mem0 is an Agent Fund portfolio company.

t_hub.title: Graphs are awesome
t_hub.sub: because relationships are where the meaning lives
t_hub.body: An interactive presentation whose structure, sequence, and camera are all generated from JSON.

t_speaker.title: Yohei Nakajima
t_speaker.body: Founder, Untapped Capital · creator of BabyAGI and Prezograph

n_untapped.title: Untapped Capital
n_untapped.tip: Pre-seed venture fund backing unexpected founders — FalkorDB is in the portfolio.

n_agentfund.title: Agent Fund
n_agentfund.tip: Backing agent-native startups — Mem0 is in the portfolio.

y_babyagi.title: BabyAGI
y_babyagi.body: a task list that runs itself
y_babyagi.tip: The autonomous agent that started the task-loop wave — a task queue the agent creates, prioritizes, and executes. The tasks form a graph.

y_insta.title: InstaGraph
y_insta.tip: Paste text or a URL, get a knowledge graph. The moment converting anything into nodes and edges felt one-click.

y_mind.title: MindGraph
y_mind.tip: Open-source starter kit for graph-as-memory — an API-first proto-CRM where the graph is the database.

y_pretty.title: PrettyGraph
y_pretty.tip: A small experiment in making text-to-graph output beautiful. Same data, better drawing — order from chaos.

y_b2.title: BabyAGI 2
y_b2.tip: Rebuilt around a function registry: functions, their dependencies, and triggers stored as a graph the agent extends — the functiongraph.

y_active.title: ActiveGraph
y_active.tip: Current work: event-sourced context graphs — the living state layer this talk keeps circling back to.

oc_order.title: Graph-native
oc_order.body: Multi-hop questions stay close to the way the problem is described.

oc_chaos.title: Relational
oc_chaos.body: Joins are powerful, but relationship-heavy questions often require more modeling and query work.

tl_hub.title: Agents became graph-shaped in public
tl_hub.body: Plans, tool calls, memory, teams, interoperability, and reusable skills all made relationships explicit.

tl_react.title: ReAct
tl_react.body: interleave reasoning + acting — the base loop

tl_fc.title: Function calling
tl_fc.body: structured tool edges from the model

tl_ag.title: AutoGen + Assistants API
tl_ag.body: Agent teams and persistent threads made conversational state and delegation explicit. The Assistants API is now deprecated.

tl_gr.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
tl_gr.body: retrieval over an entity graph + community summaries

tl_mcp.title: MCP
tl_mcp.body: open standard — tools + resources as a context graph

tl_op.title: Operator → ChatGPT agent
tl_op.body: Operator introduced browser-acting research preview capabilities later integrated into ChatGPT agent.

inv_ont_old.title: Model-first ontology
inv_ont_old.body: Useful when the domain is stable, but expensive when behavior changes faster than the model.

inv_use_old.title: usage
inv_use_old.sub: finally — if anyone still trusts it

inv_prop.title: proposals
inv_prop.sub: LLM extracts nodes + edges from traces

inv_ont_new.title: Living ontology
inv_ont_new.sub: Proposed from use · reviewed by people
inv_ont_new.body: Let repeated behavior suggest structure, then validate, govern, and version it.

st_before.title: The old job
st_before.tip: Graph-first: months of modeling before the first user query. Ends in trust decay — see the inversion.

st_after.title: The new job
st_after.body: Continuously answer five relationship questions as usage evolves.
st_after.tip: Agent-first: the workflow runs from day one and the job becomes tending the graph it generates.

mk_hub.title: A market forms around the questions
mk_hub.tip: The picks-and-shovels layer forming around living graphs — hover any segment or company for what it does and how it is doing.

seg_db.title: Graph databases
seg_db.tip: Databases purpose-built to store and traverse nodes and edges — the persistence layer for world graphs. Nine companies, from a ~$581M leader to fresh seeds.

seg_build.title: KG construction
seg_build.tip: Turn unstructured stuff — documents, web pages, audio — into nodes and edges. The 'proposals' step of the agent-first loop, as an industry.

seg_mem.title: Agent memory
seg_mem.tip: Memory layers for agents built on temporal knowledge graphs — the living agent state this talk keeps pointing at. Already consolidating: Cognee wound down in 2026.

seg_kg.title: Semantic KG platforms
seg_kg.tip: The graph-first tradition: RDF, ontologies, semantic layers — now selling provenance and governance to GenAI buyers.

seg_er.title: Entity resolution
seg_er.tip: Deduplicating people and companies across messy records — the 'identity' question as a product.

seg_viz.title: Graph viz & investigation
seg_viz.tip: Drawing the graph so humans can see the topology — investigation UIs and rendering SDKs. 'Order', productized.

co_neo4j.title: Neo4j
co_neo4j.tip: Category leader — AuraDB cloud, GraphRAG / context-graph positioning. $200M+ ARR, 80+ of the Fortune 100.

co_tigergraph.title: TigerGraph
co_tigergraph.tip: Native MPP graph database for real-time multi-hop analytics at petabyte scale. JPMC, Mastercard, Amex.

co_memgraph.title: Memgraph
co_memgraph.tip: In-memory, Cypher-compatible, streaming-first — the popular drop-in Neo4j alternative for agent workloads. M12-backed.

co_arangodb.title: ArangoDB
co_arangodb.tip: Multi-model: graph + vector + document + search in one engine; AutoGraph KG construction coming. ~$47M raised.

co_hypermodedgrap.title: Hypermode (Dgraph)
co_hypermodedgrap.tip: AI dev platform built around Dgraph, the distributed open-source graph DB it acquired. $9M seed.

co_falkordb.title: FalkorDB
co_falkordb.tip: Ultra-low-latency RedisGraph successor (sparse-matrix based), purpose-built for GraphRAG. Tel Aviv seed.
co_falkordb.body: Graph database for low-latency knowledge and agent workloads.

co_nebulagraph.title: NebulaGraph
co_nebulagraph.tip: Distributed open-source graph DB with trillion-edge deployments — dominant in Chinese internet cos. ~$40M+.

co_ultipa.title: Ultipa
co_ultipa.tip: HTAP graph DB claiming 10+ hop real-time traversal; FSI risk and fraud focus. $21M Series A.

co_puppygraph.title: PuppyGraph
co_puppygraph.tip: Zero-ETL graph query engine over Iceberg / Delta / Snowflake — query the lakehouse as a graph without moving it. Coinbase, eBay. $5M seed.

co_diffbot.title: Diffbot
co_diffbot.tip: Crawls the whole web into a 10B-entity, 1T-fact knowledge graph, sold as APIs. Tencent-backed; famously capital-efficient.

co_lettria.title: Lettria
co_lettria.tip: No-code NLP that turns complex documents into auditable knowledge graphs; GraphRAG for regulated industries. Paris.

co_graphlit.title: Graphlit
co_graphlit.tip: API-first managed KG + RAG — ingest docs, audio, web into a graph with built-in retrieval for AI apps.

co_mem0.title: Mem0
co_mem0.tip: $24M total funding announced in 2025; available as an AWS Agent SDK memory provider.
co_mem0.body: Long-term memory layer for AI agents; an AWS Agent SDK memory provider.

co_stardog.title: Stardog
co_stardog.tip: Enterprise KG that virtualizes data without moving it; Voicebox markets 'hallucination-free' semantic parsing. NASA, Morgan Stanley.

co_graphwiseontot.title: Graphwise
co_graphwiseontot.tip: Ontotext + PoolParty merger — the largest independent semantic KG vendor; GraphRAG grounding for GenAI. BBC, AstraZeneca.
co_graphwiseontot.body: Formed from the merger of Ontotext and Semantic Web Company.

co_franzallegrogr.title: Franz (AllegroGraph)
co_franzallegrogr.tip: RDF + OWL reasoning + vectors for neuro-symbolic AI since 1984. Founder-owned; gov, pharma, intel.

co_eccenca.title: eccenca
co_eccenca.tip: Corporate Memory — governed semantic data fabrics on W3C standards. Siemens, Bosch, Airbus, Bayer.

co_metaphacts.title: metaphacts
co_metaphacts.tip: metaphactory platform for ontology modeling and semantic search — acquired by Digital Science (2022).

co_timbrai.title: Timbr.ai
co_timbrai.tip: SQL-native semantic layer that turns existing warehouses into virtual knowledge graphs — ontologies in plain SQL.

co_relationalai.title: RelationalAI
co_relationalai.tip: Relational knowledge graphs as a Snowflake-native coprocessor — rules, reasoning, and graph analytics over enterprise data.

co_quantexa.title: Quantexa
co_quantexa.tip: Decision intelligence: 99%-accuracy entity resolution + graph analytics for AML / fraud / KYC. $100M+ ARR; HSBC, HMRC.

co_senzing.title: Senzing
co_senzing.tip: Jeff Jonas's entity-resolution engine, embedded in customer infra, validated to ~100B records; OEM'd by IBM and Esri.

co_tilores.title: Tilores
co_tilores.tip: Serverless real-time entity-resolution API; IdentityRAG grounds LLMs in resolved customer data. Berlin.

co_linkurious.title: Linkurious
co_linkurious.tip: Graph investigation UI used by the ICIJ for the Panama Papers; AML, fraud, intel. Acquired by Nuix (2026).

co_cambridgeintel.title: Cambridge Intelligence
co_cambridgeintel.tip: KeyLines / ReGraph JavaScript SDKs for graph visualization in mission-critical intel and security apps. Bootstrapped, profitable.

co_graphistry.title: Graphistry
co_graphistry.tip: GPU-accelerated graph visualization — a million nodes in-browser; Louie.ai adds GenAI-native investigation. In-Q-Tel, NVIDIA.

ex_reason.title: Reasoning / plans
ex_reason.tip: A plan can be modeled as tasks with dependency and prerequisite edges.

ex_world.title: World / UI
ex_world.tip: UI elements and actions form a changing graph of affordances.

ex_know.title: Knowledge / memory
ex_know.tip: The core idea: memory is an event-sourced knowledge graph — facts carry provenance and time.

ex_teams.title: Agent teams
ex_teams.tip: Delegation, review, escalation, and handoffs are relationships between agents and work.

ex_tools.title: Tools / skills
ex_tools.tip: Tools expose capabilities, permissions, inputs, outputs, and dependencies.

ex_traces.title: Traces / evals
ex_traces.sub: logs that look like a graph
ex_traces.tip: The core idea: an agent run is a graph you can replay, fork, and diff.

t_zep.title: Zep / Graphiti
t_zep.tip: Agent memory on Graphiti, an open-source temporal knowledge graph engine — sub-200ms context retrieval.

t_lsmith.title: LangSmith / Phoenix
t_lsmith.tip: Trace tooling — the raw material for treating runs as replayable graphs.

ag_trace_hub.title: Agents leave a graph behind
ag_trace_hub.sub: Even when the application never calls it one
ag_trace_hub.body: Prompts create plans; plans invoke tools; results update memory; traces feed evaluation.

tl_a2a.title: Agent2Agent (A2A)
tl_a2a.body: An open protocol for agents to discover capabilities and collaborate across systems.

tl_skills.title: Agent Skills
tl_skills.body: Filesystem-based packages make instructions, scripts, and resources composable across agent tasks.

tl_aaif.title: MCP joins AAIF
tl_aaif.body: Anthropic donated MCP to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation.

co_neptune.title: Amazon Neptune
co_neptune.body: Graph database and analytics services spanning operational graphs and GraphRAG workflows.

co_spanner_graph.title: Spanner Graph
co_spanner_graph.body: Property graph capabilities integrated with Spanner's relational platform.

oss_hub.title: This deck is a graph
oss_hub.sub: And the tool is open source
oss_hub.body: One JSON document defines reusable entities, visual instances, edges, scenes, and explicit narrative beats.

oss_repo.title: Prezograph
oss_repo.body: Validate it, select it, present it, and export a portable single-file deck.

yg_repo.title: github.com/yoheinakajima/prezograph
yg_repo.sub: Fork it · build a graph · tell a relationship

scenes.title: Graphs Are Awesome
scenes.caption: Graphs Are Awesome · Yohei Nakajima · GraphCon · July 25, 2026

scenes.title: Same facts, different relationship cost
scenes.caption: The claim is not that tables are bad. It is that relationship-heavy questions reward relationship-first models.

scenes.title: Everything is already a graph
scenes.caption: Objects matter; the relationships between them are where systems start to explain themselves.

scenes.title: Agents leave a graph behind
scenes.caption: The graph is present in the trace whether or not the application persists it as a graph.

scenes.title: Agents became graph-shaped in public
scenes.caption: Selected milestones, not an exhaustive history. Product names and statuses are current as of July 24, 2026.

scenes.title: Invert the ontology workflow
scenes.caption: A model-first ontology is still valuable in stable domains. The inversion is useful when observed behavior changes faster than the model.

scenes.title: The new job is continuous relationship governance
scenes.caption: Five durable questions turn a changing graph into a usable system.

scenes.title: A market forms around the questions
scenes.caption: Market segments monetize infrastructure layers and recurring relationship workloads; the mapping is illustrative, not exclusive.

scenes.title: The company landscape
scenes.caption: Illustrative landscape as of July 24, 2026. ◈ marks the speaker's disclosed portfolio; platform products are included alongside independent vendors.

scenes.title: Pick a relationship-shaped problem
scenes.caption: Start with one consequential relationship, make it inspectable, then widen only when the use case demands it.

scenes.title: This deck is a graph
scenes.caption: Prezograph separates reusable facts from local visual instances, then uses explicit beats to control the narrative.

scenes.title: You are a graph person
scenes.caption: The graph is not the decoration. It is the presentation model.
